catalysts.name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
catalysts.what: UnitedHealth's Q3 2026 report (13 Oct) showed adjusted EPS of $4.69 against a roughly $4.10-4.14 pre-report consensus, and the company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $20.50, up from the $19.50–$20.00 range it set in July (reported GAAP EPS was $4.56; the adjusted medical-care ratio improved 150bp to 88.4%, aided by about $610M of favorable reserve development, so part of the beat is not repeatable). Shares rose roughly 3% on the day. Membership fell y/y (50.1M to 48.3M), a caveat on the quarter's quality.

catalysts.name: Biogen Inc.
catalysts.what: JPMorgan upgraded Biogen to Overweight from Neutral on 12 Oct and raised its price target to $300 from $210 (target horizon Dec 2027; implies roughly 29% upside from this run's FMP price), citing a stronger 2027 pipeline catalyst lineup — felzartamab in antibody-mediated rejection (a market JPMorgan sizes above $2B), litifilimab in cutaneous lupus, and a possible read-through to Leqembi from Lilly's TRAILBLAZER-ALZ-3 Alzheimer's trial. UBS also raised its target the same week, to $270 from $240, but that figure differs from JPMorgan's by more than 5% so only the JPMorgan target is cited. Biogen reports Q3 2026 results 28 Oct.

catalysts.name: Haemonetics Corporation
catalysts.what: CSL Plasma disclosed that it expects to transition all of its US plasma-collection centers (300+) to Haemonetics' NexSys PCS platform by end-2027, a much larger commitment than the open-ended, partial-scope supply deal disclosed 14 Aug; CSL has signed a separate transition agreement with incumbent Terumo to unwind its Rika systems. Scope/timing remain subject to change and Haemonetics is not updating FY2027 guidance yet; it said it would give more financial detail on its November fiscal Q2 call. BTIG raised its price target to $130 from $110 (Buy) on the news — a single broker, not a consensus.

UNH.what: Diversified health-insurance and health-services company spanning UnitedHealthcare and Optum.

BIIB.what: Biotechnology company focused on treatments for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases (multiple sclerosis, SMA, Alzheimer’s).

HAE.what: Medical device company providing plasma-collection (NexSys PCS), blood-center and hospital hemostasis/coagulation-testing systems.

notices: Wed 14 Oct was a risk-off session: a hotter-than-expected September CPI report revived bets the Fed could hike again at its 27-28 Oct meeting. S&P 500 -1.1%, Russell 2000 -1.9%, Dow -0.1% (most resilient), Nasdaq Composite -1.9%; tech/AI names were the heaviest drag, health care and consumer staples the relative strongest sectors. VIX jumped to 16.87 (+10.5%) on the session.
